title: Essential-prefix gate removal strengthens the fixed BK family with an analytical proof

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total certificate-prefix language specified in proof.md and family.py. For actual length N, choose k as the least prime at least the least positive B with B^5>32*N^3; read k input bits as the lower coefficients of a monic degree-k polynomial Q over F_2, reject invalid Q by the exact Frobenius/gcd test, and evaluate the descending-power BK symmetric polynomial on the remaining N-k bits with zero padding, r=ceil((N-k)/k), t=ceil(sqrt(r)). Output 0 for N=0 or the explicit failed guards in proof.md. The output is the constant coefficient in F_2[Z]/Q. All k prefix bits are included in N; Q is input, not advice.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For the single total uniform polynomial-time certificate-prefix family defined in proof.md and family.py, C_B2(F_N)>=4N-3k-8d_N+5 for all sufficiently large integer N, where W=r(r+3)/2, H=(t-1)(t+2)/2, A0=(t-1)k-H-(r-t+1), d_N=1+W+max(A0,floor(r(k-1)/(t+1))), k=O(N^(3/5)), and d_N=O(N^(4/5)). At every sufficiently large integer N, every prefix bit is essential; fixing any accepted prefix with nonconstant payload removes at least k gates in the strengthened signed-wire/output-literal model. The new finite guarantee for this SAME family has right-hand side exceeding the preceding declared expression4N-4k-8d_N+8 by k-3>0 eventually. Consequently liminf over all integer N of C_B2(F_N)/N>=4 in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length N. Moreover (3k+8d_N-5)/(4k+8d_old-5) tends to1/2 over all integer lengths, where d_old=floor(kr/t)+kt+r(r+1)+1; this compares proved remainder certificates, not actual circuit complexities.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
